FIELD REPORT
AUGUST, 1962

Sabik's HQ infiltrated. Found the heart of MEDUSA research and production. It's in the PEARL Compound. Siberia. Where Sabik was kept. It's not just a prison, it's a research lab.

There was a folder containing a brief from John Cooper. Cooper had let Sabik stay a captive in PEARL in order to possibly glean more intel about the Soviets. This explains Sabik's reluctance to come in and possibly Cooper's disappearance.

FIELD REPORT
MAY, 1962

Sabik's operatives were planning assassination of Soviet operatives. Civilian casualties were "acceptable, given the time of great need."

He insists he did not harm or abduct Cooper but blamed the CIA for making Cooper disappear. Said Cooper might have asked too many questions, or been caught misusing agency funds.

front.transcription:
FIELD REPORT
JANUARY, 1962

Encountered Sabik.

He was difficult, refused to come in. He didn't say why. Unsure if Soviets turned him or he's gone rogue.

Told us the CIA had used him and would use us as well. Said not to trust anyone, especially not the CIA.

Told us not to tell you we found him.
